title: Homemade Miso Ramen
description: Rich, umami-packed miso broth with springy ramen noodles, a soft-boiled marinated egg, chashu pork, and classic toppings.
instructions: Marinate eggs: boil 6 minutes, peel, and soak in soy sauce + mirin mixture for at least 2 hours.
Sauté garlic and ginger in sesame oil. Add broth and bring to simmer.
Whisk miso paste into a ladle of hot broth, then stir back into the pot. Add soy sauce.
Pan-fry pork belly slices until caramelized.
Cook ramen noodles according to package instructions.
Divide noodles between bowls. Ladle hot miso broth over top.
Arrange pork belly, halved marinated egg, corn, bamboo shoots, nori, and spring onions.
Finish with a drizzle of sesame oil and serve immediately.
author: Chef Yuki
